description_en: Queries the information about a schema design ticket, such as the current node of the ticket, whether the ticket can be returned to the schema design node, and the publishing strategy
description_zh: 调用此API可获取结构设计工单当前所在环节、是否允许返回结构设计节点、执行发布的策略等信息
name: GetTableDesignProjectFlow

parameters.help_en: The ID of the schema design ticket. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/144643.html operation to obtain the ID
parameters.help_zh: 结构设计工单ID。您可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/144643.html接口获取该参数的值
parameters.name: order_id

parameters.help_en:
The tenant ID.

To view the tenant ID, go to the Data Management (DMS) console and move the pointer over the profile picture in the upper-right corner. For more information, see the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html section of the "Manage DMS tenants" topic
parameters.help_zh:
租户ID。
鼠标移动到界面右上角的头像处，查看租户ID。具体操作，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.name: tid

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code returned if the request failed
ErrorCode.description_zh: 错误码，请求异常时返回

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the request failed
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误信息

ProjectFlow.description_en: The information about the schema design process

CurrentPosition.description_en: The position of the current node in the process
CurrentPosition.description_zh: 当前结构设计流程所在节点位置

BackToDesign.description_en:
Indicates whether the ticket can be returned to the schema design node. Valid values:

1: The ticket can be returned to the schema design node.
0: The ticket cannot be returned to the schema design node. This value can be returned only for the PUBLISH node
BackToDesign.description_zh:
是否允许流程返回结构设计阶段，取值：

1：允许。

0：不允许，只能定义在PUBLISH（发布）节点上

CanSkip.description_en:
Indicates whether the current node can be skipped. Valid values:

1: The current node can be skipped.
0: The current node cannot be skipped. This value can be returned only for the PUBLISH node
CanSkip.description_zh:
是否允许跳过该当前节点，取值：

1：可以。
0：不可以，只能定义在PUBLISH（发布）节点上

NodeRole.description_en:
The role of the node in the process.

START: The ticket was created.
DESIGN: The schema is being created.
PUBLISH: The schema is published.
END: The ticket is complete
NodeRole.description_zh:
流程节点角色：

START：开始。
DESIGN：结构设计。
PUBLISH：发布。
END：结束

Position.description_en: The position of the node in the process. The value starts from 1

PublishAnchor.description_en: Indicates whether the node is the anchor node. A schema design process has only one anchor node, on which the schema is published. After the schema is published on the anchor node, a post-publish image is generated and the DDL metadata lock is released
PublishAnchor.description_zh:
定义该节点是否为发布锚点。
一个结构设计流程中有且仅有一个发布锚点，负责执行发布操作。发布锚点发布后，将生成发布后镜像、释放DDL元数据锁

PublishStrategies.description_zh: 提交发布可选择执行策略列表

items.description_en:
The publishing strategy.

IMMEDIATELY: immediately publish the schema.
REGULARLY: publish the schema at the scheduled time
items.description_zh:
选择执行发布策略：

IMMEDIATELY：立即执行。
REGULARLY：定时执行

RuleComment.description_en: The description of the security rule set that is applied to the schema design ticket
RuleComment.description_zh: 结构设计应用的安全规则集描述

RuleName.description_en: The name of the security rule set that is applied to the schema design ticket
RuleName.description_zh: 结构设计应用的安全规则集名称

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. You can use the request ID to query logs and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID，用于定位日志，排查问题

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true
false
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功，返回值说明如下：
true：请求成功。
false：请求失败
